description: Estimate a student's admission odds at one or more colleges, by round, with a likely range, from GPA and test scores (plus optional class rank, home state, legacy, first-generation, aid). Same model as prefrosh.ai/chance. Always tell the user this is an estimate from grades and scores only; essays, activities and recommendations can move it a lot. Needs at least a GPA or a test score; ask for them if missing rather than guessing.

class_rank.description: Class rank bucket, if known (percent of class).

first_gen.description: First in family to attend a four-year college.

gpa.description: Unweighted GPA, ideally on a 4.0 scale (a 100-point average also works).

home_state.description: Two-letter US state the student lives in (matters for public universities).

needs_aid.description: Will apply for need-based aid (default true).

name: my_odds
title: My admission odds
